title: Kymora: High-Throughput Batch and Streaming Time-Series Feature Extraction with a Native Rust Computational Core
description: Kymora is a batch-oriented Python time-series feature extraction library with a Rust core: contiguous NumPy buffer ingestion (no copy of the input), GIL release across the parallel region, Rayon work-stealing across the series dimension, and a curated 33-feature low-redundancy catalog computed through fused single-traversal passes.
